questions.q: Which trees did the pupils choose?
questions.e: Le texte précise qu’ils ont choisi des arbres locaux.
questions.t: Awa’s school club planted trees near the football field. The pupils chose local trees because they need less water. They made a watering schedule for the first month. Awa’s group waters the trees every Tuesday.

questions.q: When does Awa’s group water the trees?
questions.e: Le groupe d’Awa arrose les arbres chaque mardi.
questions.t: Awa’s school club planted trees near the football field. The pupils chose local trees because they need less water. They made a watering schedule for the first month. Awa’s group waters the trees every Tuesday.

questions.q: Why was Mamadou’s bus delayed?
questions.e: La pluie forte a retardé le bus.
questions.t: Mamadou’s bus to Saint-Louis was delayed by heavy rain. He sent a message to his aunt and waited inside the station. When the bus arrived, he checked the number before getting on. He reached his aunt’s house before dinner.

questions.q: What did Mamadou check before boarding?
questions.e: Il a vérifié le numéro du bus.
questions.t: Mamadou’s bus to Saint-Louis was delayed by heavy rain. He sent a message to his aunt and waited inside the station. When the bus arrived, he checked the number before getting on. He reached his aunt’s house before dinner.

questions.q: Why did Fatou choose the more expensive basket?
questions.e: Elle a choisi les fruits frais.
questions.t: At the market, Fatou compared the prices of two baskets of oranges. One basket was cheaper, but several oranges were damaged. She chose the other basket because the fruit was fresh. The seller gave her a small discount.

questions.q: What does “damaged” mean in this text?
questions.e: Damaged veut dire abîmé.
questions.t: At the market, Fatou compared the prices of two baskets of oranges. One basket was cheaper, but several oranges were damaged. She chose the other basket because the fruit was fresh. The seller gave her a small discount.

questions.q: Until what day may students borrow books?
questions.e: Les élèves peuvent emprunter des livres jusqu’à vendredi.
questions.t: The school library closes at five, but students may borrow books until Friday. They write their names and the book title in a notebook. A student who returns a book late must speak to the librarian. Mariama borrowed a story about the sea.

questions.q: What must a student do after returning a book late?
questions.e: Le texte dit qu’il faut parler à la bibliothécaire.
questions.t: The school library closes at five, but students may borrow books until Friday. They write their names and the book title in a notebook. A student who returns a book late must speak to the librarian. Mariama borrowed a story about the sea.

questions.q: Why should people close the well cover?
o: To keep dust and insects out
To stop the well from getting deeper
questions.e: Le couvercle protège l’eau de la poussière et des insectes.
questions.t: During the dry season, a village committee repaired a well. The work took three days, and families brought water in clean containers. The committee asked everyone to close the well cover after use. This helps keep dust and insects out.

questions.q: How long did the repair work take?
questions.e: Les réparations ont duré trois jours.
questions.t: During the dry season, a village committee repaired a well. The work took three days, and families brought water in clean containers. The committee asked everyone to close the well cover after use. This helps keep dust and insects out.

questions.q: What did Aminata do with new words?
o: She taught them on the radio
questions.e: Elle écrivait les mots puis les utilisait dans des phrases.
questions.t: Aminata wanted to practise English, so she listened to a short radio programme each evening. She wrote down three new words and used them in sentences. After two weeks, she could understand more of the programme. She still asked her teacher about difficult words.

questions.q: How did her listening change after two weeks?
questions.e: Après deux semaines, elle comprenait davantage.
questions.t: Aminata wanted to practise English, so she listened to a short radio programme each evening. She wrote down three new words and used them in sentences. After two weeks, she could understand more of the programme. She still asked her teacher about difficult words.

questions.q: What did the players do before warming up?
questions.e: Le coach leur a demandé de boire et de s’étirer.
questions.t: A football team arrived early for its match. The coach asked the players to drink water and stretch before warming up. The match began at four o’clock. Their goalkeeper saved a penalty in the second half.

questions.q: When did the goalkeeper save a penalty?
questions.e: Le texte dit que c’était pendant la deuxième mi-temps.
questions.t: A football team arrived early for its match. The coach asked the players to drink water and stretch before warming up. The match began at four o’clock. Their goalkeeper saved a penalty in the second half.

questions.q: What did the health worker demonstrate?
questions.e: Elle a montré comment se laver les mains.
questions.t: The health worker visited the school to talk about handwashing. She showed the pupils how to use soap and clean water. A poster near the classroom sink reminds them to wash before eating. The pupils made a song to remember the steps.

questions.q: When does the poster remind pupils to wash?
questions.e: L’affiche rappelle de se laver avant de manger.
questions.t: The health worker visited the school to talk about handwashing. She showed the pupils how to use soap and clean water. A poster near the classroom sink reminds them to wash before eating. The pupils made a song to remember the steps.

questions.q: What did the farmer plant?
questions.e: Le texte indique qu’il a planté du millet.
questions.t: A farmer planted millet after the first good rain. He removed weeds by hand and checked the field each week. His daughter helped count the rows. They planned to store the harvest in dry bags.

questions.q: How often did he check the field?
questions.e: Il vérifiait le champ chaque semaine.
questions.t: A farmer planted millet after the first good rain. He removed weeds by hand and checked the field each week. His daughter helped count the rows. They planned to store the harvest in dry bags.

questions.q: Where did Ousmane take the wallet?
questions.e: Il a apporté le portefeuille au bureau d’information.
questions.t: At the bus station, Ousmane saw a wallet on a bench. He took it to the information desk instead of keeping it. The worker checked for an identification card and called the owner. The owner returned later to thank Ousmane.

questions.q: Why could the worker call the owner?
o: The owner was on the bus
questions.e: La carte d’identité permettait de contacter le propriétaire.
questions.t: At the bus station, Ousmane saw a wallet on a bench. He took it to the information desk instead of keeping it. The worker checked for an identification card and called the owner. The owner returned later to thank Ousmane.

questions.q: What difference did the class test?
o: How often the plants received water
How much sunlight the room received
questions.e: La fréquence de l’arrosage changeait.
questions.t: The science class placed two plants near a window. One plant received water every day, while the other received water only once a week. After several weeks, the daily-water plant was taller. The class recorded the changes in a table.

questions.q: Which plant became taller?
questions.e: La plante arrosée chaque jour était plus haute.
questions.t: The science class placed two plants near a window. One plant received water every day, while the other received water only once a week. After several weeks, the daily-water plant was taller. The class recorded the changes in a table.

questions.q: Why did Binta pack a notebook?
o: To give it to the museum
questions.e: Elle voulait noter les objets intéressants.
questions.t: Before the school trip, Binta packed a hat, a water bottle and a notebook. Her teacher asked everyone to stay with a partner at the museum. Binta wrote down the names of three objects she found interesting. She shared her notes with the class the next day.

questions.q: What rule did the teacher give at the museum?
questions.e: La consigne était de rester avec un camarade.
questions.t: Before the school trip, Binta packed a hat, a water bottle and a notebook. Her teacher asked everyone to stay with a partner at the museum. Binta wrote down the names of three objects she found interesting. She shared her notes with the class the next day.
